intent: One concise English post per current blog, linking to full article

findings.message: All ten posts match their supplied articles and full-blog URLs. The benchmark reports remain separate, with no universal superiority, SLA, customer, or operational guarantees invented. All post text is ASCII and under 280 raw characters including URLs.
